title: Poor quality Chinese cheap toys! Fake wine for a treat?
text: Box of poor quality toys, all made in China! Nothing I would ever buy for my cats. The bottle of Meow Y Chandon Pet Winery Salmon and Catnip infused bottle of water was useless.  The old cat loved one toy. The young cat walked away. If the fake wine was a treat...well, lets just say that this box IMHO wasn't worth the $12 prime price. More plastic for the landful. Both cats usually like even the card board box and won't let me throw them out. They didn't give this a second look! Will go back to our reg. company!  Giving 2 stars instead of one because it arrived a week early but thats probably due to my prime membership.
label: negative
